rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration confirms the RCA from iteration_5 has been correctly addressed. iteration_5 identified two operator-precedence bugs (JS precedence: `===` > `??` > `?:`) where `?:` was folded into a `??` chain, silently discarding analytics.totalRevenue in favour of summary.revenue and mislabelling non-empty verificationStatus as 'Verified'. Main agent's fix eliminated the ambiguity by (1) rewriting revenue as an imperative if/else block that reads analytics.totalRevenue → analytics.revenue → summary.revenue in strict priority order, and (2) rewriting Verification as an explicit ternary chain with the string-check as the outer branch. Both approaches are mechanically incapable of exhibiting the previous bug because the `??` / `?:` operators are no longer interleaved in a single expression.
